name: Gapless Player
description: Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues in the web client. The stock HTML audio player remains the fallback.
overview: Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues.

versions.changelog: FLAC tracks start playing after their first ~256 KB instead of after the full download. If the download falls behind playback, playback pauses at that point and continues once more has arrived. Other formats are unchanged. Requires Jellyfin 12.4 or later; 12.3 servers keep 0.1.0.8.

Gapless Web Audio playback for eligible audio queues. Injects into the stock web client in-memory (no web-root writes); now-playing-bar on/off toggle; download progress in the seek bar while a track loads; optional now-playing browser notifications (plugin setting); repeat and shuffle; seek and unpause near the end of a track start immediately; accurate playback reporting (every track start is paired with one stop at the right position, so played marks, resume points and scrobbling are correct, also on album switches and stop); pause takes effect while a track is still loading; pause, seek, skip and play-next keep working while the browser resumes audio after a background interruption (mobile); graceful fallback to the normal player for undecodable tracks, also when skipping or resuming; strips leading ID3 tags so tagged FLAC decodes gaplessly. Requires Jellyfin 12.3 or later.
